item.title: Qatar called on all parties to exercise restraint and avoid escalation that threatens freedom of navigation, the global economy and the cha…
item.description:
Qatar called on all parties to exercise restraint and avoid escalation that threatens freedom of navigation, the global economy and the chances of a deal. Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari said the state of "no war, no peace" is raising energy and food prices and disrupting supply chains, and that threats to Gulf security or to navigation in Hormuz could hinder any peace agreement, stressing that hope for a diplomatic agreement is what drives Doha to persist in mediating between Washington and Tehran.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/qatar-urges-restraint-amid-ongoing-negotiation-efforts · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738497/qatar/qatar-calls-on-all-parties-to-show-restraint-in-crisis

item.title: The Foreign Ministry spokesperson said the mutual defence agreement with Turkiye is part of Qatar's effort to strengthen its defence capabi…
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry spokesperson said the mutual defence agreement with Turkiye is part of Qatar's effort to strengthen its defence capabilities and safeguard its sovereignty and territorial integrity, and that regional states are working on a new security framework based on collective defence and developing national defence industries, welcoming the Makkah Defence Alliance as a contribution to Gulf security.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/qatar-urges-restraint-amid-ongoing-negotiation-efforts · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738497/qatar/qatar-calls-on-all-parties-to-show-restraint-in-crisis

item.title: His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Amir, began the first state visit by a Qatari Amir to Switzerland, running on 18 and 19 N…
item.description:
His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Amir, began the first state visit by a Qatari Amir to Switzerland, running on 18 and 19 November, with a programme that includes a Joint Economic and Financial Commission and an AI forum bringing the two sides together. Swiss Ambassador Florence Tinguely Mattli said mediation is an area in which the two countries have built trust, and that the partnership's potential lies in innovation, research and education. His Highness visits Germany on Friday.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/qatari-amirs-first-state-visit-to-switzerland-marks-new-chapter-in-ties · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738495/qatar/hh-the-amir-embarks-today-on-visits-to-switzerland-germany

item.title: Qatar Central Bank issued the "Guide on Bank Commission and Fee Ceilings Collected from Individuals and Micro-Enterprises" under the Third …
item.description:
Qatar Central Bank issued the "Guide on Bank Commission and Fee Ceilings Collected from Individuals and Micro-Enterprises" under the Third Financial Sector Strategy, capping fees in five service categories: deposits and accounts, NAPS/Himyan debit cards and credit cards, credit facilities, fund transfers, and cheques, with the aim of enhancing transparency, protecting customer rights and promoting financial inclusion.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264822/latest-news/qcb-issues-new-guide-setting-fee-ceilings-for-banks-services-to-individuals-micro-enterprises · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-central-bank-issues-guide-setting-bank-fee-ceilings-for-individuals-micro-enterprises

item.title: MEEZA signed a contract worth more than QR100 million with an unnamed leading Qatari entity to establish and operate a dedicated sovereign …
item.description:
MEEZA signed a contract worth more than QR100 million with an unnamed leading Qatari entity to establish and operate a dedicated sovereign cloud region hosting an enterprise resource planning platform, along with managing a secure data centre and keeping all data inside Qatar, according to the company's disclosure on the Qatar Stock Exchange website. The company expects the contract to start contributing to its revenue in 2026.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264818/latest-news/meeza-signs-over-qr100-million-sovereign-cloud-deal · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/meeza-signs-more-than-qr100-million-sovereign-cloud-deal

item.title: Qatar lost a friendly 1-0 to South Korea at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium on Tuesday evening, Oh Se-hun scoring with a header in the 43rd mi…
item.description:
Qatar lost a friendly 1-0 to South Korea at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium on Tuesday evening, Oh Se-hun scoring with a header in the 43rd minute. Korea had 21 shots, 9 on target, while Qatar had no shot on target, and goalkeeper Salah Zakaria stood out. Questions are being raised over the future of coach Julen Lopetegui, whose contract ends in April 2027.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/republic-of-korea-compound-qatar-woes-with-1-0-victory · The Korea Times https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/20261118/s-korea-defeat-qatar-in-final-match-of-year

item.title: The Bahrain Defence Force said on Wednesday morning that its air defences intercepted several Iranian air attacks, which it called part of …
item.description:
The Bahrain Defence Force said on Wednesday morning that its air defences intercepted several Iranian air attacks, which it called part of a "systematic campaign" against the kingdom, and the Interior Ministry issued two successive alerts telling residents to move to the nearest safe place before announcing the all-clear. In Kuwait, the General Staff said air defences were countering hostile drone attacks, while Iran's army claimed its drones targeted a Patriot system and launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base, without Kuwaiti or US confirmation.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-war-iran-attacks-bahrain-kuwait-drone-threats-keep-gulf-on-high-alert-as-us-hits-irans-qeshm-1.500751444 · Daily Pakistan https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/18-Nov-2026/us-patriot-missile-defense-system-targeted-in-iranian-attack-at-kuwait-air-base · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/gulf-nations-on-high-alert-after-us-strikes-irans-qeshm-island

item.title: GCC Secretary General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi condemned the "repeated" Iranian attacks on Bahrain, saying any attack on the kingdom is an i…
item.description:
GCC Secretary General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi condemned the "repeated" Iranian attacks on Bahrain, saying any attack on the kingdom is an infringement on the security of all GCC states, and urged the UN Security Council to act. Jordan condemned the attacks as "a clear breach" of Bahrain's sovereignty, and Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi called his Bahraini counterpart Abdullatif Al Zayani to affirm Amman's unwavering support.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-war-iran-attacks-bahrain-kuwait-drone-threats-keep-gulf-on-high-alert-as-us-hits-irans-qeshm-1.500751444 · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/jordan-condemns-irans-repeated-attacks-on-bahrain

item.title: The spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen, Maj Gen Turki Al Malki, announced the destruction of 60 Houthi military …
item.description:
The spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen, Maj Gen Turki Al Malki, announced the destruction of 60 Houthi military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah, Amran and Saada, including mountain tunnels storing ballistic missiles and drone assembly workshops, and then announced on Wednesday morning the interception and destruction of a cruise missile the Houthis fired towards the Riyadh region.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://english.aawsat.com/gulf/5342575-coalition-destroys-60-houthi-military-targets-4-yemeni-regions · A News (Anadolu) https://www.anews.com.tr/middle-east/2026/11/18/saudi-led-coalition-says-it-destroyed-60-houthi-targets-in-yemen · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738507/region/coalition-forces-intercept-cruise-missile-launched-toward-riyadh-region

item.title: Sultan Haitham bin Tarik received a written message from Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, delivered by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi …
item.description:
Sultan Haitham bin Tarik received a written message from Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, delivered by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi at Al Alam Palace, and Araghchi briefed His Majesty on Iran's latest initiative to end the war with the United States. The Sultan called for continued consultations among regional states to prevent escalation, while Araghchi praised Oman's role in de-escalation and bridging views.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199827/oman/his-majesty/hm-receives-written-message-from-iranian-president · Social News XYZ (IANS) https://www.socialnews.xyz/2026/11/17/iranian-fm-omani-sultan-discuss-regional-tensions-diplomatic-initiative

item.title: Oman and Uzbekistan raised their relations to a strategic partnership during President Shavkat Mirziyoyev's visit, exchanging at Al Alam Pa…
item.description:
Oman and Uzbekistan raised their relations to a strategic partnership during President Shavkat Mirziyoyev's visit, exchanging at Al Alam Palace a terms-of-reference document, a framework agreement, six agreements, 21 memoranda of understanding and a cooperation programme, including mutual visa exemption for ordinary passport holders and the creation of a new commercial bank in Uzbekistan. The two countries identified a joint investment portfolio of about $5 billion and a target of raising bilateral trade to $1 billion.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199853/oman/visa-exemption-new-bank-among-oman-uzbekistan-accords · Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199798/business/economy/oman-uzbekistan-sign-5-billion-in-new-deals · Trend News Agency https://www.trend.az/casia/uzbekistan/4247482.html

item.title: Oil prices fell in Asian trading on Wednesday: Brent to $92.61 a barrel (−0.57%), US crude to $85.06 (−1.10%) and Murban to $91.39 (−4.22%)…
item.description:
Oil prices fell in Asian trading on Wednesday: Brent to $92.61 a barrel (−0.57%), US crude to $85.06 (−1.10%) and Murban to $91.39 (−4.22%), after American Petroleum Institute data showed crude stocks up 5.28 million barrels and gasoline up 5.12 million barrels, while Hormuz risks limited the losses.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/energy/oil-slips-in-asia-led-by-murban-brent-wti-what-to-know-on-nov-18-2026-1.500751476 · HDFC Sky https://hdfcsky.com/news/brent-crude-oil-price-today-november-18-2026-brent-falls-0-5percent-to-92-6-wti-drops-1-15percent-as-us-stockpiles-rise-middle-east-risks-limit-losses

item.title: President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi announced at the World Economic Forum strategic dialogue session in Cairo that the "National Transformation …
item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi announced at the World Economic Forum strategic dialogue session in Cairo that the "National Transformation Programme 2027–2030" will be launched in December to raise economic productivity, deepen integration into value chains and empower the private sector. He cited growth of 5.1% in FY2025/2026, foreign direct investment of $18 billion, reserves of about $57.5 billion at end-October, and a target of raising industry's share of output to 20% by 2030.
Sources: Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5772493 · Yahoo Finance (Euronews) https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/egypt-pitches-reforms-energy-plans-144536389.html · Osoul Misr Magazine https://www.osoulmisrmagazine.com/452879

item.title: President El-Sisi said Cypriot gas will reach the Idku and Damietta liquefaction plants for export to Europe by 2028 and that renewables wi…
item.description:
President El-Sisi said Cypriot gas will reach the Idku and Damietta liquefaction plants for export to Europe by 2028 and that renewables will supply 45% of electricity by the same year, estimating Suez Canal revenue losses in recent years at about $20 billion as transits improve. He discussed with EBRD President Odile Renaud-Basso the creation of new investment zones.
Sources: Yahoo Finance (Euronews) https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/egypt-pitches-reforms-energy-plans-144536389.html · Osoul Misr Magazine https://www.osoulmisrmagazine.com/452879

item.title: Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly today, Wednesday, witnessed the official launch of the "Nevira" tourism project at the government headqu…
item.description:
Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly today, Wednesday, witnessed the official launch of the "Nevira" tourism project at the government headquarters in the New Capital, alongside chairing the weekly cabinet meeting. Details of the project and the size of its investment have not yet been announced.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2531465 · Khalf Elhadth https://khalfelhadth.com/160398 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/97142

item.title: Egypt drew 0-0 with Malawi in Lilongwe in the fourth round of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, moving to 8 points after winning t…
item.description:
Egypt drew 0-0 with Malawi in Lilongwe in the fourth round of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, moving to 8 points after winning the first leg 5-0 in Cairo. Goalkeeper Mostafa Shobeir made several saves, and a Mohamed Salah shot hit the crossbar in the second half.
Sources: Cairo Mubasher https://www.cairomubasher.com/253709 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/sports/sports_news/details/2026/11/17/3080121/%D9%85%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%B5-%D9%85%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85-%D8%A3%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A7-2027

The dollar held steady against the pound in Egyptian banks on Wednesday: EGP 53.67 buy and 53.77 sell at National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr and Banque du Caire, and 53.68 and 53.78 at Commercial International Bank, while the euro stood at EGP 58.94 buy and 59.14 sell at National Bank of Egypt.

item.title: 21-karat gold held at EGP 5,900 a gram on Wednesday after falling about EGP 215 from the previous day, with 24-karat at about EGP 6,745, 18…
item.description:
21-karat gold held at EGP 5,900 a gram on Wednesday after falling about EGP 215 from the previous day, with 24-karat at about EGP 6,745, 18-karat at about EGP 5,055 and the gold pound at EGP 47,200, as the global ounce fell below $3,800.

item.title: South Korea's KOSPI closed Wednesday up 1.99% at 5,067.44, reclaiming 5,000 and snapping a three-day losing streak, led by SK hynix (+4.19%…
item.description:
South Korea's KOSPI closed Wednesday up 1.99% at 5,067.44, reclaiming 5,000 and snapping a three-day losing streak, led by SK hynix (+4.19%) and Samsung (+2.31%) after Nvidia's results, and the won rose to 1,333 per dollar despite net foreign selling of about 327.3 billion won. The Nikkei rose 1.03% and the Taiex 1.13%.
Sources: The Korea Times https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/others/20261118/kospi-retakes-5000-after-nvidia-earnings-results-spur-chip-rally · Korea JoongAng Daily https://koreajoongangdaily.com/business/kospi-jumps-nearly-2-as-korean-chipmakers-rise-with-nvidia-earnings-report/12979529 · TradingView (CNBC TV18) https://www.tradingview.com/news/cnbctv:352a14e2e094b:0/

item.title: European shares opened Wednesday little changed after their biggest one-day drop since March: the STOXX 600 at 650.73, with technology up 1…
item.description:
European shares opened Wednesday little changed after their biggest one-day drop since March: the STOXX 600 at 650.73, with technology up 1.2% and ASML up 1.8% on Nvidia's support, against mining down about 3% to a near nine-month low and Glencore down 3.5%, while Experian jumped 3.7% after results beat estimates and a $500 million buyback.
Sources: Yahoo Finance (Reuters) https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/european-shares-muted-tech-offsets-082501845.html · Rallies (Reuters) https://rallies.ai/news/european-shares-muted-as-tech-offsets-mining-weakness-cb1c264ce70b1b26

item.title: Spot gold fell about 1.5% to $3,792 an ounce, its lowest in more than a year, and silver 2.6% to $46.117, after St Louis Fed President Albe…
item.description:
Spot gold fell about 1.5% to $3,792 an ounce, its lowest in more than a year, and silver 2.6% to $46.117, after St Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said the economy may need "several more rate hikes before spring". Futures price a 92% probability of a 25 basis point hike next month, and markets await the Fed minutes tonight.
Sources: Yeni Safak https://en.yenisafak.com/economy/gold-falls-below-3800-an-ounce-on-fed-tightening-signals-3725712 · EDNews https://ednews.net/en/gold-plunges-below-3800-as-fed-rate-hike-bets-and-strong-dollar-bite/

item.title: Anthropic prices its initial public offering of 825 million shares tonight in a $70 to $78 range, with orders near seven times the shares o…
item.description:
Anthropic prices its initial public offering of 825 million shares tonight in a $70 to $78 range, with orders near seven times the shares on offer and single orders of $10 billion or more. At the top of the range the valuation is about $1.4 trillion and proceeds about $64.4 billion, with trading due to begin Thursday on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.
Sources: TokenPost https://www.tokenpost.com/news/business/59957 · Forbes Middle East https://forbesmiddleeast.com/money/markets/anthropic-heads-into-possible-record-ipo-with-orders-near-7-times-shares-on-offer · TradingView (CNBC TV18) https://www.tradingview.com/news/cnbctv:352a14e2e094b:0/

item.title: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen for the APEC summit, his first in-person appearance since 2017, ahead of the first thr…
item.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen for the APEC summit, his first in-person appearance since 2017, ahead of the first three-way summit with Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping on Thursday 19 November. Washington says nuclear arms reduction and the war with Iran will dominate, while whether Ukraine is on the agenda remains unsettled.
Sources: Kyiv Post https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90410 · SANA https://sana.sy/en/international/2359135/

item.title: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Kyiv is preparing a large-scale prisoner exchange agreed at the trilateral Abu Dhabi talks and …
item.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Kyiv is preparing a large-scale prisoner exchange agreed at the trilateral Abu Dhabi talks and is ready to deliver results "in the coming weeks" depending on how fast Russia responds, and proposed Oleshky-style humanitarian operations in 10 more occupied settlements in Kherson and Zaporizhzhia, announcing a round of talks in Berlin this week with broader European participation.
Sources: WebIndia123 https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articles/World/20261118/4521053.html · UA.NEWS https://ua.news/en/ukraine/zelenskii-anonsuvav-pidgotovku-velikogo-obminu-polonenimi-z-rosiieiu · Yahoo News (Kyiv Independent) https://www.yahoo.com/news/world/articles/ukraine-proposed-oleshky-humanitarian-operation-174941176.html

item.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in Manila there is no evidence that the wave of major tech outages in the United States, including a…
item.description:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in Manila there is no evidence that the wave of major tech outages in the United States, including a nationwide air traffic ground stop and a disruption of Microsoft systems, are linked or caused by hostile actors: "They're all separate and they're distinct… We are not under systemic attack," declining to speculate on any role for artificial intelligence.
Sources: The Peninsula (Washington Post) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/rubio-says-recent-us-tech-outages-unrelated-not-hostile-acts · The Edge Malaysia https://theedgemalaysia.com/node/826267
